status: Concept renders and Figma components; runtime 3D meshes and texture maps are not yet implemented.
style: Grounded semi-realistic environmental props; restrained wood, clay, iron, canvas and concrete.

implementation.behavior: All five are static, impassable one-tile blockers for the cube and insects. Visual variation only; no pushing, destruction, damage, loot or new scoring.
implementation.selection: Use a separate deterministic hash salt to select one of five visuals, preserving current occupancy and safe start area.
implementation.geometry: Model the broad silhouettes in actual 3D; use baked base-color, normal and roughness textures for bark, rust, weave and aggregate. The PNGs are concept/guide portraits, not runtime geometry or texture maps.
implementation.budget: Target 600–1800 triangles per model (valve up to 2400); 1–2 materials per model, shared atlas and shared geometry. Final budgets require profiling.
implementation.lighting: MeshStandardMaterial, smooth normals, predominantly rough surfaces; no emissive surfaces. Match existing arena light.
implementation.repetition: Seed quarter-turn rotation and slight material tint; prevent scaling beyond tile boundary.
implementation.streaming: Integrate with existing worldMeshes tile streaming; share resources and dispose them once at their owning lifecycle boundary.
validation: Baked detail survives mipmaps without shimmer
